up: Return rows for bioactivities where the assay target is the human single-protein target CHEMBL3974. Filter for activities with a standard_type of 'IC50' and a valid pChEMBL value. Retrieve the following columns: the ChEMBL ID of the assay (assays.chembl_id), the target type (target_dictionary.target_type), the target taxonomy ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), the canonical SMILES of the molecule (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the ChEMBL ID of the molecule (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the standard type (activities.standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Limit the output to the first 1000 rows. Order the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID and then by the assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  target_dictionary.target_type,
  target_dictionary.tax_id,
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles,
  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  activities.standard_type,
  activities.pchembl_value
FROM activities
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3974'
  AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
